original_question_en: List the most recently submitted TDocs targeting Rel-19 (latest Rel-19 activity).
original_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-19'}), (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type, t.status, m.canonicalMeetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

original_Korean_row.question: Rel-19 타겟 Tdoc 중 최근 제출된 목록은?
original_Korean_row.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-19'}), (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type, t.status, m.canonicalMeetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

design_binding: Tracked HEAD old path blob, freshly reopened; byte-identical to earlier indexed snapshot, not to modified current worktree file.
read_only_SQL:
SELECT t.node_id,t.tdocNumber,t.title,t.type,t.status,t.uploadedDate,t.reservationDate,m.canonicalMeetingNumber,m.meetingNumberInt FROM Tdoc t JOIN rel_TARGET_RELEASE rt ON rt.src_id=t.node_id
       JOIN Release r ON r.node_id=rt.dst_id JOIN rel_PRESENTED_AT pa ON pa.src_id=t.node_id
       JOIN Meeting m ON m.node_id=pa.dst_id WHERE r.releaseName='Rel-19' ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC,t.tdocNumber ASC
